result.summary: The home screen is mostly well laid out. One visible defect: the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the Popular right now card is truncated or has a broken final glyph. Two minor issues also stand out: low-contrast secondary text and a delivery pill that overlaps the image edge.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' renders with a clipped or malformed last character (it reads 'Rameı'). This is not a carousel edge, since the card is full width and there is plenty of space. It looks like a text-rendering or clipping bug, or a font glyph problem.
issues.suggestion: Check the text container's width, padding and overflow, and the font's glyph coverage. Make sure the full name renders, or use proper ellipsis truncation if it is too long.

issues.description: Secondary text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', the '(500+)' rating count) is light gray on white and has low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast.

issues.description: The time pills ('15–25 min', etc.) on the 'Fastest near you' cards sit tight against the bottom-left corner of the image and slightly overlap the image edge. This looks cramped, and the pill on the first card appears to collide with the plate image.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent inset padding for the overlay pills and make sure they don't overlap the key image content.
